about: The City of Coral Springs describes Downtown in December as interactive holiday lights on the City Hall lawn throughout December. The city lists dates from Tuesday, December 1 through Thursday, December 31, 2026, with the page marked free.

The city page names its related events: Light Up the Lawn on December 5, the Holiday Parade on December 9, and a Deck the Halls Holiday Map. The Light Up the Lawn page adds that the December 5 celebration is the official start of the holiday season with the City Hall Tree Lighting Ceremony.

The city's events directory lists City Hall at 9500 West Sample Road, Coral Springs 33065. For accessibility help the city asks guests to call the Special Events number at 954-344-1111 or email events@coralsprings.gov at least five days before an event.
A South Florida Family Life roundup lists the Holiday Parade on Wednesday, December 9, from 7 PM to 9 PM along Sample Road as free, so a family can see the lawn lights on the parade night.
faq: When is Downtown in December?
December 1 to 31, 2026, on the City Hall lawn.
Is it free?
Yes, the city page marks it free.
Where is it?
City Hall Lawn, 9500 West Sample Road, Coral Springs.
What other events are connected?
Light Up the Lawn on December 5 and the Holiday Parade on December 9.
Is there a map?
The city lists a Deck the Halls Holiday Map.
Who do I call for accessibility needs?
The city Special Events number, 954-344-1111, at least five days before the event.

about: First Church Coral Springs lists five Bethlehem Revisited evenings in 2026: Friday, December 11 from 7 PM to 9 PM, Saturday, December 12 and Sunday, December 13 from 6 PM to 9 PM, and Monday, December 14 and Tuesday, December 15 from 7 PM to 9 PM. Instagram posts for the event give the address as 8650 West Sample Road.

The church describes it as a living interactive recreation of the town of Bethlehem. As you enter the city gates you inscribe your name for the census taker, then meet townspeople, livestock and the imposing Imperial Roman Army.

In the marketplace, shop owners explain how papyrus, candles and furniture are made, and visitors can eat fresh bread from the bakery and visit the apothecary. You can break bread with a Jewish family keeping the Sabbath and visit the inn that turned Mary and Joseph away.

The walk ends at a manger scene with Mary, Joseph and Jesus surrounded by angels. Then you follow the road to the sanctuary, where storytellers, singers, musicians and actors bring moments of Jesus' life to life. The church page does not print a price, a parking note or any age guidance.
faq: When is Bethlehem Revisited 2026?
December 11 to 15. Weekend evenings are 6 PM to 9 PM and weeknights are 7 PM to 9 PM.
Where is it?
First Church of Coral Springs, 8650 West Sample Road.
What happens?
A walk through a recreated Bethlehem with a census, market, inn, manger scene and sanctuary storytelling.
Is there a price?
The church page does not print one.
Is it indoors or outdoors?
The church page does not say.
Do we need tickets?
The church page does not mention tickets.
Is there a Santa?
No, it is a nativity themed walk-through.

about: Simon lists Santa Photos at Coral Square from November 20 to December 24, 2026, at the North Main Entrance. The mall is at 9469 West Atlantic Boulevard, according to a Coral Springs and Parkland Christmas guide that checked venue pages.

The daily schedule changes. Weekday afternoons are generally 2 PM to 7 PM, Sundays 11 AM to 7 PM, Black Friday and Saturday 10 AM to 7 PM, December 5 is 10 AM to 8 PM, and December 12 is 10 AM to 9 PM. From December 14 to 18 Santa is available 10 AM to 8 PM, December 19 is 9 AM to 9 PM, December 21 to 23 are 9 AM to 9 PM, and Christmas Eve is 9 AM to 5 PM.
Thanksgiving Day is closed. The host page links to Where Is Santa to make a reservation, and it does not print a price or any pet policy.

The same guide lists Santa Paws pet photos on Sunday, November 29, 6:30 to 8:30 PM, and a sensory friendly Caring Santa on Sunday, December 6, 9:30 to 10:30 AM, at the mall, though those dates are not on the Simon page itself.
faq: When is Santa at Coral Square?
November 20 to December 24, 2026, with hours that change by day.
Where do I find him?
The North Main Entrance of Coral Square.
Is Santa there on Thanksgiving?
No, the host shows Thanksgiving Day as closed.
Do I need a reservation?
The host page links to Where Is Santa to make one.
How much does it cost?
The host page does not print a price.
What are the longest days?
December 12 until 9 PM, and December 19 to 23 from 9 AM to 9 PM.
Is there a sensory friendly visit?
A Coral Springs and Parkland guide lists Caring Santa on December 6 from 9:30 to 10:30 AM.

about: The Holiday Fantasy of Lights site describes three miles of giant animated holiday lights and illuminated trees in Tradewinds Park, Coconut Creek. The drive-through season is November 21, 2026 through January 2, 2027, open nightly from 6 PM to 10 PM.

The park entrance is at 3600 West Sample Road, according to the show's Facebook page. Miami Kids Magazine lists the show as open every night, holidays included, with $34 per car at the gate. That price is from the magazine, not the show's own site.

Miami Kids Magazine also says kids can drop letters in the official North Pole mailbox. The show's own page says it supports Gilda's Club of South Florida, which provides resources for children affected by cancer, and Toys for Tots.
A drive-through show suits babies and toddlers who nap in the car seat, and families who want lights without a long walk in the evening.

The host says Holiday Fantasy of Lights began 32 years ago as South Florida's first holiday lights drive-thru, and that the 2026 edition will again be outstanding in size, scale, movement and illumination. The displays are presented by Brandano Displays, Inc., and photos on the page show a poinsettia entrance arch, a jack-in-the-box, penguins, a snowboarder, lit trees and toy soldiers.
The host says the price is per car, so bring family, friends and pets. Tickets are sold on the host's Buy Tickets page, and a VIP email list offers early bird sale news.
A portion of ticket sales benefits Gilda's Club of South Florida. The show is also an official drop-off for Toys for Tots, so guests can bring new unwrapped toys to the event.
faq: When does Holiday Fantasy of Lights run?
November 21, 2026 to January 2, 2027, nightly from 6 PM to 10 PM.
Where is it?
Tradewinds Park, 3600 West Sample Road, Coconut Creek.
How long is the drive?
The host describes three miles of lights.
How much is it?
The host page does not print a price. Miami Kids Magazine lists $34 per car at the gate.
Is it open on holidays?
Miami Kids Magazine lists it open every night, holidays included.
Is there something for kids to do?
Miami Kids Magazine mentions an official North Pole mailbox for letters.
Which charities does it support?
Gilda's Club of South Florida and Toys for Tots.
Can pets come along?
Yes, the host says to bring family, friends and pets, and the price is per car.
How old is the show?
The host says it began 32 years ago as South Florida's first holiday lights drive-thru.
Who builds the displays?
Brandano Displays, Inc.
Is there a toy drive?
Yes, it is an official Toys for Tots drop-off for new unwrapped toys.

about: Coral Springs Center for the Arts lists The Nutcracker Ballet presented by the International Ballet Company on Saturday, December 12 at 2 PM and 8 PM, and on Sunday, December 13 at 2 PM.

The Center's Christmas listings also include a Nutcracker Suite on Tuesday, December 15 at 7 PM and We Three Kings on Saturday, December 19 at 7:30 PM, according to a Coral Springs and Parkland Christmas guide.
The venue is at 2855 Coral Springs Drive. The Center's page does not print ticket prices, an age recommendation or a running time, so call or check the box office before you buy.
Tickets are sold through the Center's ticketing page, which this listing links.

The Center calls this its 27th annual Nutcracker and says it has hosted the International Ballet Company's holiday tradition for over a quarter of a century. The page says the full-length performance follows the original Marius Petipa production with stage effects, costumes and Tchaikovsky's score.

The story follows Marie, who receives a Nutcracker from her godfather Dr. Drosselmeyer. After a Christmas Eve celebration and a battle with the Giant Rat King, her Nutcracker becomes a Prince and they travel through a winter wonderland to the Kingdom of Sweets, where Marie becomes the Sugar Plum Fairy.

The page says the production sells out each year and advises booking early. The page header gives December 11 to 13, but only the December 12 and 13 performances are listed with ticket links, so this listing shows those three.
faq: When is the Nutcracker at the Center?
Saturday, December 12 at 2 PM and 8 PM and Sunday, December 13 at 2 PM.
Who performs?
The International Ballet Company.
Where is it?
Coral Springs Center for the Arts, 2855 Coral Springs Drive.
What do tickets cost?
The venue page does not print a price.
Is there an age recommendation?
The venue page does not give one.
How long is the show?
The venue page does not give a running time.
Are there other holiday shows?
A Nutcracker Suite on December 15 and We Three Kings on December 19 are listed in a local guide.
What is the story?
Marie receives a Nutcracker, battles the Giant Rat King and travels to the Kingdom of Sweets.
Does it sell out?
The Center says it sells out each year.
Which version is it?
A full-length production rooted in Marius Petipa's original, with Tchaikovsky's score.
How many years has the Center hosted it?
The Center says over a quarter of a century, calling this the 27th annual Nutcracker.
